info.description: A group of collaborators. Leave the list empty and it fills itself from the event this page belongs to.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Layout
edit.description: Natural sets them in a plain row. Carousel is the home page's turning ring. Grid fills the width, three across.

edit.label: How many
edit.description: At most ten. It applies only when the list below is left empty.

edit.label: Collaborators
edit.description: Drag them into the order they should read in. Leave this empty and the listing fills itself from this page's event, up to the number above.
